sloka: अश्म वर्षम् विमुंचन्ती भैरवम् विचचार सा।ततः तौ अश्म वर्षेण कीर्यमाणौ समन्ततः ॥१-२६-२०॥
transliteration: aśma varṣam vimuṁcantī bhairavam vicacāra sā।tataḥ tau aśma varṣeṇa kīryamāṇau samantataḥ ॥1-26-20॥

translations.english: On seeing them hit and thrown about by a rain of stones from all sides, the auspicious son of Gadhi, (Viswamitra) spoke these words:
